body.x: Clair, an air purifier made in Korea has made an appearance in 'CES 2017' held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th. It has demonstrated the sleep stimulation and sound therapy device, 'ClairS' along with the deodorization and anti-bacterial air purifier, 'ClairV'.

At CES, Ha Eun Hee, the vice president of Clair, said, "A famous startup media company Tech Crunch based in U.S has shown interest in the air purifier ClairS and we have conducted an interview with them. All of the company is discussing for the simultaneous launch of the device in crowd funding websites like Kickstarter and Indeigogo. We are so excited about people's interest in Clair. We expect more demand for Clair's new products in the U.S market in the future".

The new product ClairS is a result of an innovative concept that has excellent air purification ability with IoT technology and even a Bluetooth speaker. It is a sound therapy and air purifier that has a recording function and sounds that can help with sleep induction, meditation, mind and body stability, and concentration.

This device can be controlled from a smart phone. Not only can you use it for playing your music for daily use, you can also use it for sleep induction, relaxation or for tranquility, and when in need of concentration for studying or working. It can be versatile and be used in various situations.

ClairV is an excellent air purifier to deodorize and sterilize bacteria around the house. It is good for refrigerators, shoeboxes, cars, and toilets. Also, a new battery will last for 3 months, which is efficient.

All the products of Clair are made from a patented technology from 27 countries that uses electrostatic to collect dust with MAF filters. It shows excellent ability to purify air and MAF filters does not use OIT or chemical coating for fighting bacteria, which makes it safe for humans.

It is guaranteed to remove ultrafine dusts that are less than 0.1μm, as well as substances that can cause allergies and sick house syndrome. It also collects all the harmful substances such as yellow dust, cigarette smoke, and more. With a low electricity consumption, the device will use up electricity that is equal to 100 Won per month. With little financial burden, you can breathe fresh and clean air at all times.
